create_actor_critic_model: create an actor-critic model using create_actor_critic with cfg, obs_space, and action_space arguments
build_shared_weights_actor_critic: build a shared-weight actor-critic network by setting cfg.actor_critic_share_weights to True
build_separate_weights_actor_critic: build a separate-weight actor-critic network with independent actor and critic encoders and cores
review_forward_head_method: review the forward_head method that normalizes observations and passes them through the encoder
review_forward_tail_method: review the forward_tail method that produces action distributions, log probabilities, and value estimates
